consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT. No repo file currently imports a React Aria TimeField, so this is a forward-looking verdict only: if a time input is added before Base UI ships date/time components, it must be built on react-aria-components or on native <input type="time"/>, not on Base UI.
notableDifferences: Base UI's nearest primitives are Input (text) and Number Field (numeric with increment/decrement + scrub) — neither models time segments, 12/24-hour locales, or timezone offsets.

The unshipped Base UI design (per internals/temporal) expects a date-library object (date-fns/luxon adapter) and a TemporalTimezone ('default'|'system'|'UTC'|string) — a different data model from @internationalized/date/Time.
